secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Enables AI extraction, action-plan writing, and plain-language explanations (Google AI Studio API key). Optional: without it the app uses local rule-based extraction and plans.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional alternative AI provider used only when GEMINI_API_KEY is not set (OpenAI Platform API key).

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional: enables /admin with a token of at least 24 characters. Leave unset to keep the admin dashboard disabled.
